final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference (sinks 1uA IREF)
MB   ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=1
* tail current source 2uA
M5   tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=2
* NMOS input pair (weak inversion) - inputs swapped for correct polarity
M1   x     vinn  tail vss nfet W=10 L=1
M2   out1  vinp  tail vss nfet W=10 L=1
* PMOS mirror load (longer L for higher rout)
M3   x     x     vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=1
M4   out1  x     vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source (6x M4 density) + NMOS sink (6uA)
M6   vout  out1  vdd vdd pfet W=48 L=1
M7   vout  ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=2 m=6
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor (LHP zero)
Rz   out1  nz    25k
Cc   nz    vout  2.7p
.ends
